title.en: Well-styled haircuts and careful nail grinding

text.en: Pet owners visiting this Northwest Dallas salon praise the grooming results for both dogs and cats, including Maine Coons and kittens. Reviewers highlight neat breed cuts tailored to owner instructions, summer trims to reduce shedding, pet-safe coat dyeing, and thorough nail grinding on dark nails alongside gland expression.

Clients describe the owner, front desk receptionist, and grooming technicians as welcoming, flexible, and attentive. Several reviewers appreciate that the team asks detailed questions at drop-off to understand the exact haircut style desired and provides reliable service over repeated visits.

title.en: Patient handling for dogs and cats

text.en: Reviewers note that their pets are treated with care during grooming, daycare, and boarding stays. Owners of anxious puppies and feisty kittens mention that the groomers know how to keep animals calm and comfortable, with dogs arriving excited for daycare and returning home relaxed.

q.en: Does Furry Tails groom cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention bringing kittens and adult cats such as Maine Coons for baths and haircuts.

q.en: What is the drop-off and pick-up policy for grooming appointments?

a.en: Clients note that dogs with grooming appointments can be dropped off in the morning and picked up at closing without an extra daycare charge.

q.en: Does Furry Tails offer standalone nail grinding and gland expression?

a.en: Yes, pet owners bring dogs in specifically for nail grinding and anal gland expression.

q.en: How do reviewers rate the pricing at Furry Tails?

a.en: Clients consistently describe the prices for grooming, daycare, and boarding as fair and reasonable.
